geometry: A white square-cornered note silhouette on a transparent background. The 2-pixel-wide stem runs from (10,1) to (12,15), and the 8-by-5-pixel note head spans (4,10) to (12,15), on a 16-by-16 canvas.
limitations: The source uses axis-aligned solid shapes; no material visual limitations observed after inspecting native and enlarged renders on light and dark backgrounds.
